description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Inheritance class, which manages template inheritance logic including initializing inheritance, handling child templates, processing blocks, and rendering parent or child blocks within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Inheritance
classes.description: Class responsible for managing template inheritance, including initializing inheritance trees, processing nested blocks, handling child templates, and rendering parent/child blocks within Smarty templating system.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes inheritance setup for a given template, handling nested inheritance levels, and optionally starting output buffering for child templates.

methods.name: endChild
methods.description: Handles the completion of a child template, cleans output buffer if needed, and may trigger rendering of the parent template if specified.

methods.name: instanceBlock
methods.description: Creates an instance of a block class, associating it with the current inheritance state, and processes it if necessary.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a block object, managing its visibility, parent-child relationships, and deciding whether to call or process nested blocks.

methods.name: callChild
methods.description: Triggers rendering of a child block within the current template context.

methods.name: callParent
methods.description: Calls the parent block, allowing inheritance of block contents, throws exception if parent is absent.

methods.name: callBlock
methods.description: Executes the block's callBlock method, managing source context switching for template source handling.
